nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API route that promotes a candidate XGBoost model from a retrain run to active production status.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Handles model promotion requests, validates admin auth via api-guard, and marks a candidate retrain output as active.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API route that kicks off the S6 XGBoost retrain pipeline run on demand.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Triggers the S6 retrain workflow after admin auth and returns the resulting run summary.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API route running the scraped-video quality gate that decides whether scraped data is fit for training.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Invokes the scraped-video quality-gate evaluator and returns pass/fail report data to admins.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin transcription endpoint that resolves TikTok download URLs and produces speech-to-text transcripts for analysis.

nodes.name: getTikTokDownloadURL
nodes.summary: Resolves a TikTok share/post URL into a direct video download URL usable by the transcription pipeline.

nodes.name: transcribeVideo
nodes.summary: Downloads a video and runs speech-to-text to produce a transcript with timing metadata.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler exposing a transcribe-by-URL query operation for admins.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler accepting a video URL or upload and returning the transcribed text plus metadata.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that runs the unified testing framework across multiple modules and reports aggregate results.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Executes selected test suites through the unified testing framework and returns per-suite outcomes.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns metadata about available unified-testing suites and their last-run status.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint returning aggregate API usage and billing summary metrics.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the current usage summary payload for admin dashboards.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin orchestration endpoint for the validation system covering accuracy, drift, and calibration checks.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Runs validation actions (accuracy check, recalibration, drift scan) via the validation system service.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns validation-system dashboards including last-run metrics, drift status, and recent error samples.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint reporting validation metrics over a rolling 48-hour window, including precision@K and ECE.

nodes.name: precisionAtK
nodes.summary: Computes precision@K for a ranked prediction list against ground-truth labels.

nodes.name: expectedCalibrationError
nodes.summary: Computes the expected calibration error (ECE) over binned confidence buckets.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns validation metrics for the past 48 hours including precision@K and ECE per cohort.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint breaking down validation metrics by cohort/niche for finer-grained debugging.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns per-cohort validation breakdown including precision@K and ECE per slice.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint listing predictions that are still pending ground-truth validation.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns predictions awaiting evaluation, with auth and rate-limit gating.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint returning recent validation errors for triage in dashboards.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent prediction validation errors with auth and rate-limit checks.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin server-sent events stream emitting live validation events as predictions are graded.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Opens an SSE connection that pushes live validation events sourced from the calibration store.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint returning a top-line validation summary (calibration, accuracy, drift) for dashboards.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Aggregates current calibration stats into a summary payload for admin overview dashboards.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint reporting statistics about the viral-genomes corpus (count, niches, recency, quality tiers).

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Computes aggregate viral-genome statistics across niches and quality buckets and returns dashboard payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin viral prediction hub endpoint orchestrating omniscient databases, DNA sequencer, optimizer, singularity, validation, and the main prediction engine.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler returning composite viral-prediction hub status, recent predictions, and module health.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler dispatching actions (complete-prediction, DNA, optimize, singularity, validate) to the corresponding services.

nodes.name: getSystemStatus
nodes.summary: Collects per-module readiness signals to produce an aggregate viral-prediction system status.

nodes.name: getOmniscienceStatus
nodes.summary: Reports the omniscient database and integration readiness used by the prediction hub.

nodes.name: getRecentPredictions
nodes.summary: Loads recent viral predictions from storage and shapes them for dashboard consumption.

nodes.name: getSystemHealth
nodes.summary: Returns rolled-up health booleans for the viral-prediction subsystems.

nodes.name: getSystemOverview
nodes.summary: Assembles a top-line overview of module counts, statuses, and capability flags for the hub UI.

nodes.name: runCompletePrediction
nodes.summary: Runs the full prediction pipeline by wiring DNA sequencer, optimizer, singularity, and main prediction engine into a single result.

nodes.name: runDNAAnalysis
nodes.summary: Invokes the script DNA sequencer to break a script into structural genes for downstream prediction.

nodes.name: runOptimization
nodes.summary: Runs the real-time script optimizer against a given input and returns improved variants.

nodes.name: runSingularity
nodes.summary: Invokes the script singularity service to generate convergent high-viral candidate scripts.

nodes.name: runValidation
nodes.summary: Runs validation-system checks on the most recent predictions and returns the verdict.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint returning real-data accuracy validation results for viral predictions (no mock fallback).

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Pulls labeled-video outcomes from Supabase and computes accuracy metrics for shipped viral predictions.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint orchestrating accuracy validation runs, evidence generation, and targeted prediction reruns.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns aggregate and per-niche accuracy metrics for viral predictions over a configurable window.

nodes.name: getDetailedValidationData
nodes.summary: Collects detailed per-prediction validation records used to drill into accuracy diagnostics.

nodes.name: generateAccuracyEvidence
nodes.summary: Builds an evidence bundle (charts, sample predictions, statistics) supporting the reported accuracy.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Re-runs accuracy validation across selected prediction IDs and returns updated metrics.

nodes.name: validateSpecificPredictions
nodes.summary: Validates a specific set of prediction IDs against ground truth and aggregates per-id outcomes.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint generating the daily viral recipe book with real or mock data and optional performance enhancement.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the daily recipe book payload, falling back to a mock book when prediction data is unavailable.

nodes.name: generateRealRecipeBook
nodes.summary: Builds the daily recipe book from real prediction-engine output and recent viral patterns.

nodes.name: generateMockRecipeBook
nodes.summary: Returns a richly seeded mock recipe book for dashboards when the real pipeline cannot produce a fresh one.

nodes.name: enhanceWithPerformanceData
nodes.summary: Augments recipe-book entries with measured performance data (views, engagement, viral-score).

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint reporting the readiness and health of every module in the viral-prediction pipeline.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Aggregates module statuses, pipeline health, and processing statistics into a single dashboard payload.

nodes.name: getAllModuleStatus
nodes.summary: Probes every pipeline module to determine status (ready/degraded/down) and last-error metadata.

nodes.name: getModuleDescription
nodes.summary: Maps a module key to a human-readable description for use in the pipeline status UI.

nodes.name: getDefaultModules
nodes.summary: Returns the canonical list of pipeline modules with stub statuses when live probing is unavailable.

nodes.name: calculatePipelineHealth
nodes.summary: Computes an overall pipeline health score from individual module statuses.

nodes.name: getProcessingStatistics
nodes.summary: Loads recent processing statistics (counts, latencies, errors) for the pipeline status dashboard.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Accepts pipeline-control commands (restart module, retry failed runs) and dispatches them.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint for synchronous real-time viral-prediction analysis on submitted scripts/videos.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Runs the main viral-prediction engine on submitted input and returns the analysis result inline.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the configuration and capabilities of the real-time viral-prediction analyzer.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin websocket bootstrap endpoint that returns connection metadata or a graceful stub when sockets are disabled.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns websocket connection info for admin clients, gated by env-configured feature flags.

nodes.summary: Root admin API route delegating session checks to NextAuth admin auth options.

nodes.name: GET

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Invokes the advisor service with a request payload and returns structured advice plus rationale.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns advisor capabilities and supported request shape for discovery clients.
